title: Malaysia Accelerates Sabah Defenses as Military Buildup Near Balabac Advances
detail: Malaysia is accelerating defensive measures in Sabah as a military buildup near Balabac Island advances, reflecting heightened regional security concerns along the contested waters between Malaysia and the Philippines. The moves signal Kuala Lumpur's response to increased military activity near the Balabac Strait, a strategically vital chokepoint connecting the South China Sea and the Sulu Sea.
